text: Dear Sam, I joined the music club because I really enjoy singing and meeting new friends. We practise every Tuesday after class, and the teacher is very kind. Please come and visit us next week because I think you will like it too.
Dear Sam, I joined the sports club because it is fun and healthy. We play basketball after school and everyone helps each other. You should join us one day because the club is friendly and exciting.

Dear Sam, I joined the drama club because I like acting and learning new things. First, we practise short plays, and then we perform for other students. Please come and visit next Friday because it will be fun.
Dear Sam, I joined the art club. It is nice. I like draw. You come.

Dear Sam, I joined the science club because I enjoy building small robots and doing simple experiments. We meet on Monday after school, and I always learn something new. Please visit us next week because I want to show you our latest project.

Dear Sam, I joined the art club because I like painting and making posters. The club is interesting, and the teacher explains everything clearly. You should visit us because it is creative and friendly.

My best day at school was our sports day last term. First, my class prepared together, and then I ran in two races. It was special because everyone cheered for each other, and I learned that teamwork can make difficult things easier.

My best day at school was when our class went on a museum trip. It was special because I saw many old objects and talked with my friends. I learned that history can be interesting when teachers explain it well.

My best day at school was our reading festival because I met a writer and asked many questions. After that, I wrote my own short story in class. The day was special because it made me more confident, and I learned that reading can change how I think.
My best day at school is good. We have fun. I happy because friends. I learn many thing.

My best day at school was our class science fair. First, we built our project in teams, and then we presented it to teachers and parents. It was special because I felt proud of my work, and I learned that careful practice helps people speak with confidence.

My best day at school was our music performance. I was nervous at first, but my classmates helped me stay calm. The day was special because we worked as a team, and I learned that practice can turn fear into confidence.
